hero.headline: 80 Years of Pride.
hero.text: Eight decades of past pupils from Senanayake Central College (National School), Madampe. Reconnect with your batch, back the school's next chapter, and carry its light forward.
hero.caption: The main building, lit for the 80th year

join.text: Stay connected with the latest college news, association updates, upcoming events and activities. Reconnect with your classmates and expand your network.
